fetch_openml_dataset: fetch a dataset from OpenML by name or data_id with caching and target column selection
download_data_to_bunch: download ARFF data from OpenML and load it into a Bunch object with feature and target columns
verify_target_data_type: verify that target columns have homogeneous data types compatible with scikit-learn
get_json_content_from_openml_api: load JSON data from an OpenML API endpoint with retry logic and local caching
get_data_info_by_name: search OpenML for a dataset by name and version, returning the first matching active dataset
